steps.step: Prepare separate Contracts for relations, the confidentiality prompt in both directions, a restricted target, the Matter links, and ending and archiving; and two open Matters
steps.expected: Prerequisite records exist for this role
steps.actual: Open Contracts A=C-225, B=C-226, C=C-227, E=C-228, F=C-229, H=C-230, J=C-231; Confidential D=C-232, G=C-233, I=C-234; open Matters M1=M-83, M2=M-84. Priya Raman is on none of their teams.

steps.step: Set parent: Cancel leaves no parent; Set parent places A under B; B lists A under Children; choosing A as B's parent is refused as a cycle
steps.expected: Parent relation saves; Cancel changes nothing; a parent choice that creates a cycle is refused
steps.actual: Cancel left C-225 with no parent. The picker showed "Set parentC-226DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B administrator 1790580940394CancelSet parent"; Set parent saved. C-225: "Related contractsAdd linkParentC-226 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove parent". C-226: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkChildrenC-225 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A administrator 1790580940394Draft". Choosing C-225 as C-226's parent was refused: "That contract already sits under this one. Pick another parent."; C-226 still has no parent.

steps.step: Add link Related, Renews and Amends from A to C; check direction on both records; a duplicate Renews is refused; the picker does not offer A itself
steps.expected: Typed links save with the stated direction; self-links and duplicates are refused
steps.actual: Related, Renews and Amends answered 201, 201, 201. C-225: "Related contractsAdd linkParentC-226 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 B administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove parentRelatedC-227 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove linkRenewsC-227 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove linkAmendsC-227 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove link". C-227: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRelatedC-225 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove linkRenewed byC-225 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove linkAmended byC-225 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 A administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove link". A second Renews answered 409: "These two contracts are already linked that way.". In C-225's own picker a title search found C-226, and a search for C-225's own title offered: "No contracts to link." (not C-225 itself); a direct self-link write answered 409.

steps.step: Remove link on the Related row removes only that relationship; Remove parent clears the parent; both records still exist
steps.expected: Removal affects only the chosen relationship
steps.actual: Links before: amends,related,renews; after Remove link on the Related row: amends,renews (3 rows had named C-227). Remove parent cleared the parent. C-225 now reads "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRenewsC-227 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove linkAmendsC-227 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 C administrator 1790580940394DraftRemove link"; C-226 and C-227 still exist.

steps.step: Flag as confidential? after linking Confidential D to open E: the prompt names E and Flag as confidential sets E's flag
steps.expected: The prompt names the Contract that is not yet Confidential and sets only that flag
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-232 is confidential but C-228 is not. Flag C-228 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". Flag as confidential (200) set C-228 Confidential; C-232 stays Confidential.

steps.step: Flag as confidential? after linking open F to Confidential G: the prompt names F (this Contract) and accepting sets F's flag
steps.expected: The flagged Contract can be this Contract
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-233 is confidential but C-229 is not. Flag C-229 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". Flag as confidential (200) set this Contract C-229 Confidential.

steps.step: No, leave it open after linking open H to Confidential I changes nothing; a reader without access to I sees Restricted contract on H and cannot open I
steps.expected: The link does not change either flag or grant access; the restricted target does not leak its details
steps.actual: Prompt: "Flag as confidential?C-234 is confidential but C-230 is not. Flag C-230 as confidential too?No, leave it openFlag as confidential". No, leave it open kept C-230 open and C-234 Confidential; the link exists. Priya Raman's C-230 card: "Related contractsSet parentAdd linkRelatedRestricted contract" with no link to C-234; a direct read of C-234 answered 404; the relations read does not include its title.

steps.step: Link to Matter: search, inspect the M- reference, Link; the card then offers Unlink and no Link to Matter; Unlink before moving to another Matter; a confidentiality mismatch warns without changing flags
steps.expected: One Matter at a time; the mismatch advice changes neither flag
steps.actual: C-231 search offered "M-83 DOC-032 compat compat-b C20 M1 administrator 1790580940394"; Link answered 201; the card then showed 1 Unlink and 0 Link to Matter buttons. A second link to M-84 answered 409. After Unlink, the Contract linked to M-84 (201). Confidential C-232 -> open M-83: the dialog warned "These records have different Confidential flags. Linking will not change either one."; after Link, "Confidentiality differsC-232 and M-83 keep independent Confidential flags. Consider aligning them if that matches the work. This suggestion changes neither record.Leave them as they are"; Leave them as they are kept C-232 Confidential and M-83 open.

steps.step: End: use the Stage control to choose Expired (Ended); check Status and History; the Contract remains editable; the default Contracts view excludes it until Filter -> Show ended; reopen with Active and History keeps the Expired change
steps.expected: Ending records the lifecycle change without freezing the record; the ended filter reveals it; reopening is another recorded change
steps.actual: Stage control -> Expired set Status Expired (stage ended); a Description edit then saved (200). History showed "Daniel Okafor changed the statusDraft → Expiredthis minute". The Contracts list (view "Default view; previously selected Default view") did not list C-231 after paging; Filter -> Show ended ("Filter1") listed it. Choosing Active reopened it (Active); History still shows the Expired change and the Active change.

steps.step: Archive from Contract actions: Archived marker and read-only message; Status unchanged; linked Contract and Matter are not archived and the Matter's Linked Contracts omits it; find it with Show archived plus Show ended; Restore from Contract actions and from the known C- address
steps.expected: Archiving is separate from ending; restore re-enables editing and keeps the Status
steps.actual: Related link to C-227 (201); Status Expired. Archive showed the Archived marker and "This contract is archived — it is out of the contract list. Restore it to edit."; Title was not editable; Status stayed Expired. C-227 and M-84 were not archived; Before archiving M-84's Linked Contracts listed C-231; while archived it read "Linked Contracts0New contractLink ContractNo Contracts are linked to this Matter.". List filter started as "Filter"; Show archived alone ("Filter1") did not list the Ended record; with Show ended too ("Filter2") it did. Restore from Contract actions removed the marker and re-enabled editing; Status still Expired, so the default view still excludes it. Archived again (200), the known /contracts/231 address offered Restore (1) and restored it. Afterwards the reviewer cleared its list filters ("Filter" before) and re-selected view "Default view".
